method: Reviewed repository HTML and user-facing translation strings only. Selectors below name literal HTML IDs or data-i18n attributes; translation_keys name rendered copy in the listed script. No member data, authenticated API response, admin-only panel or upstream service was used as knowledge.

sources.fact_scope: Club directions, public game/lab/resource navigation, beginner welcome and the public contact QR entry. No contact identity or QR contents were extracted.
Navigation, invitation registration/binding, code check-in versus review-pending course check-in, bilingual and Beijing-time theme behavior. No award amounts or review guarantees.

Public entry descriptions only: Python/C++ materials, code/course check-in, points exchange, feedback and login/binding requirement for Chat. No gated textbook body, shop items, prices or member messages were imported.
Login gate only. Resource synopsis is sourced from the public club-features entry, not gated content or PDF/download targets.
Experiment categories and displayed learning purposes, without model-strength claims.
Beginner welcome, teaching directions, application field labels and explicitly source-bound static ECA wording.
sources.freshness_boundary: The Tuesday/Thursday 15:45–17:10 text is a statement in this source snapshot, not live confirmation of any week, holiday or changed schedule. Recheck current announcements or contact the club. No submitted application was read.

sources.fact_scope: Static self-service account, invitation, binding, password-reset and points navigation instructions. No profile, name, class, account ID or points record was read.

Local history, export/clear behavior, provider transmission, displayed attachment bounds and UTC quota error guidance. No quota value, paid plan, fixed free allowance, conversation or attachment content.

Public assistant purpose, source checking, club-configured model and separate local record/privacy copy. Describes the current implementation draft, not proof of deployment or enabled runtime availability.
Static event/signup purpose and card labels for status, location, start and deadline. No fetched announcement, event, deadline, participant or signup result was read.
Member-only gate and refresh instruction. No ranking rows, balances, identities or admin controls.

review_boundary: Knowledge consists of verified static public feature descriptions and conservative self-service navigation. Member-gated pages contribute gate labels only unless the same general instruction is already exposed by public member-center, guide or club-features copy. Operational outcomes, live schedules, events, points, prices and inventory remain unknown. The FAQ's unknown/contact advice is editorial navigation guidance grounded in the contact, invitation and feedback entries; it is not evidence of an action or resolution. Source paths are root-relative HTML URLs. Import is manual and drafts stay unpublished until explicit publication.
